opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members: Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within 6 years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C open to PhD student and postdoctoral members within 6 years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on genetics research, with three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as studying or working in the UK, or the course is held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Funded by income from the journal Heredity, this grant covers travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project whose results would be suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member can apply, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Provides an award of up to £60/day to support members with caring responsibilities to attend a Society meeting or event, applied for prior to the meeting and claimable in arrears.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting

amount.raw: Several levels of sponsorship: a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session for up to about £1,000, or as major sponsor of an entire meeting potentially several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorships between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, for use towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance). Applications may be made at any time of the year.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs (UK-based only).

opportunities.title: SIG (Special Interest Group Funding)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings (Special Interest Groups).
